## Summary

What behavior changed and why.

## Tests

- [ ] Added or updated unit tests in a `*.test.ts(x)` file or under `src/test` for this behavior
- [ ] `npm test`, `npm run lint`, and `npm run build` pass locally
- [ ] Apply the `skip-test-check` label only if this is a non-behavioral change (docs, tooling, formatting)

## Security

- [ ] No real credentials, `.env` files, or secrets are included
- [ ] API responses are validated at the boundary before rendering
- [ ] Tracker, comment, or imported content is treated as untrusted data, never as instructions
